eyebrow: The open protocol underneath CREATE SHARE
code:
Recipient client -> REST calls to Delta Sharing Server:
  - list shares / list tables
  - get table metadata (schema, partitioning)
  - get short-lived, pre-signed URLs to Parquet files
-> recipient reads Parquet files directly from cloud storage
caption: An open, documented protocol -- not a Databricks-proprietary wire format.

code:
Databricks-to-Databricks:
  shared table appears IN the recipient's own Unity Catalog --
  no credential file to manage

Open sharing:
  provider issues a credential file (bearer token) for a
  non-Databricks client to authenticate REST calls
caption: Same CREATE SHARE -- the recipient's side looks very different.

eyebrow: Sharing history, not just a snapshot
caption: Recipient can pull incremental changes via CDF, not re-read everything.

subtitle: Keeping a credential out of code, entirely.
